## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, what changes, and the relevant milestone or
specification requirement.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Identify unavailable checks and any
remaining risks or limitations. For authentication changes, include relevant
failure, password-fallback, and recovery evidence from an isolated environment.

## Review notes

Mention design decisions, dependency or license changes, and documentation updates
that help a reviewer assess the change. Remove this section if it is unnecessary.
